link_fixes.original_markdown: The startup example uses `ambient` for game/UI feedback. On iOS it respects silent mode and mixes with other apps. The module default is `playback`; Android validates either value without changing its output. Shut down before changing the policy. Use the [interactive session controls](../example/README.md#audio-session) to compare them.

link_fixes.original_markdown: The event arrives when the pattern ends, about 1 ms after the sum of its step lengths, not when you call. A 30 second pattern reports after 30 seconds. Swing and FIR draining can leave sound after completion; the event does not certify audible silence. The [interactive example](../example/README.md#pattern-completion-and-replacement) demonstrates completion, replacement and shutdown.
